Name: Ana's Toned Down Sprites - SVE add-on available
Author: anatxse
Description:
Simple sprite recolors of the vanilla character sprites so they look less jarring in toned down map recolors. Now with an add-on for Stardew Valley Expanded!

[img]https://imgur.com/7MM9NOC.png[/img]﻿[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI to generate the config.json.
[*]Disable any characters you already have overhauls for, the packs will conflict.
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/vHcIBXp.png[/img]﻿[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Install the latest version of Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿.
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.

[*]Download the SVE sprites add-on from the optional files and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[/list][img]https://imgur.com/8sTFYmS.png[/img]﻿
If a mod replaces sprites, my mod and optional add-ons will [b]not[/b] be compatible. This is why I've included configuration options (config not currently supported for SVE add-on)
Examples of incompatibilities include:[list]
[*]Character replacements
[*]Slightly Cuter Characters
[*]Diverse Stardew Valley
[*]Seasonal Outfits
[*]And anything else that replaces sprites
[/list]Over time, I intend to create more add-ons for expansions or sprite overhauls as I receive permission to do so. If you have requests, please let me know in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3943?tab=posts]posts tab[/url]﻿. Just know that I create these in my free time and don't have a ton of time to dedicate to these!

[img]https://imgur.com/7a6bIW6.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Creator of Stardew Valley - ConcernedApe
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded sprites - FlashShifter, Poltergeister, and team
[/list]
﻿[img]https://imgur.com/9ulSeNO.png[/img]﻿[list]
[*]Intended to be paired with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3939]Toned Down Portraits[/url]﻿ mod.
[*]If you enjoy this mod, consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/anatase]buying me a coffee[/url]!
[*]Submit requests for add-ons in my [url=https://discord.com/invite/DBJgYJjXq9]Discord[/url], and tag me on [url=https://anatxse.tumblr.com/]tumblr[/url] if you use my mod ♡
[/list][size=1]Tiny reminder: don't forget to endorse if you enjoy this! It makes he author happy and means more people will see it :)[/size]
